name: non_hash_keys
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM building_footprints WHERE source_id NOT LIKE 'hash_%'

name: geom_null
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM building_footprints WHERE geom IS NULL

name: area_null
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM building_footprints WHERE footprint_area_sqm IS NULL

name: invalid_geom
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM building_footprints WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geom)

name: geom_types
sql: SELECT string_agg(k||'='||n, ',' ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT GeometryType(geom) k, count(*) n FROM building_footprints GROUP BY 1) s

name: stories_null
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM building_footprints WHERE estimated_stories IS NULL
